full_prompt_en: A square ultra-wide fisheye photograph transforms a waterfront harbor into a circular world around a vast central sky. Rows of closely packed brick buildings bend along the top edge, their windows and rooflines tilting inward as they follow the lens distortion. At the lower edge, paved quays and narrow streets curve up from both corners, while a dark sheltered harbor occupies the bottom center. White boats are moored in clusters on the left and right, their small hulls repeating around the curved shoreline. The center is dominated by a nearly round dome of blue-gray cloud, mottled with darker patches and broken by silver and warm peach light near the low horizon. That thin golden strip lies just above a narrow harbor mouth at the middle bottom. A distorted reflection of the glowing clouds stretches down the dark water. The fisheye projection makes buildings and docks form a dense ring, leaving the cloudy sky as the open interior of the frame. Detail is photographic rather than illustrated: facades show many small windows, boats are crisp enough to read as individual craft, and the cloud surface has uneven natural texture. The palette remains cool slate blue, brown brick, and charcoal, with sunset gold restricted to the horizon and water glints. Light filters through the cloud break, creating soft highlights without strong cast shadows. The whole view feels both documentary and impossible, its strict circular distortion turning an ordinary harbor panorama into a contained, dramatic little planet.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超广角鱼眼摄影把滨水港湾变成围绕巨大中央天空的圆形世界。密集排列的砖楼沿顶边弯曲，窗户和屋顶线随着镜头畸变向内倾斜。下缘处，铺面的码头和窄街从两角向上弯起，深暗的避风港占据下方中央。白色小船成群停泊在左右两侧，细小船身沿弧形海岸重复。画面中心由一片近乎圆顶的蓝灰云占据，表面带深浅斑块，低地平线附近透出银白与暖桃色的破云光。那条细金色亮带刚好位于下方中央的狭窄出港口上方。发光云的扭曲倒影沿暗水延伸。鱼眼投影使建筑和码头围成密集环圈，让多云天空成为画幅开阔内核。细节属于摄影而非插画：立面有许多小窗，船清楚到可辨个体，云面具有不均匀的自然肌理。调色维持冷石板蓝、砖棕和炭灰，落日金仅留在地平线与水光里。光穿过云缝，形成柔高光却没有强烈投影。整幅视野既纪实又不可能，严格的环形畸变把普通港湾全景变成包裹起来的戏剧性小星球。
style_prompt_en: Ultra-wide fisheye photography bends a continuous panorama into a dense circular perimeter surrounding a broad sky-like center. Straight facades, streets, and shoreline lines arc strongly near the frame edges, while small repeated details remain photographically crisp. A cool slate and charcoal atmosphere is interrupted by a thin warm band of low light and its elongated reflection. Mottled cloud texture gives the open center weight; compact built and floating forms provide scale around the rim. Soft filtered illumination favors natural tonal gradation over hard shadows. The main rhythm is an inward pull from richly detailed curved edges toward the luminous narrow horizon, making familiar spatial relationships feel self-contained and uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 超广角鱼眼摄影把连续全景弯成密集圆周，包住宽阔的天空般中心。原本笔直的立面、街道和岸线在画幅边缘强烈拱曲，而小尺度重复细节仍保持摄影般清楚。冷石板与炭灰空气被一条低位暖光细带及其拉长反射打断。云斑肌理为开放中心增加重量；紧凑的构筑与漂浮形体在周缘提供尺度。过滤后的柔光偏爱自然明度渐层，而非硬阴影。主要节奏由细节丰富的弯曲边缘向发光的狭窄地平线内收，使熟悉空间关系显得封闭又奇异。
theme_en: A harbor and old waterfront curved around a circular stormy sky
theme_zh: 港湾与旧城滨水区环绕成圆形风暴天空
name: Fish-eye view
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
